name: TCC Group Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: TCC Group Holdings Co., Ltd. manufactures and markets cement, cement-related products, and ready-mixed concrete in Asia, Europe, and Africa. It operates through Cement, Electricity and Energy, Social Aspect of Energy Transition, and Other segments.
